adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` and then `await createEvent(...)` inside the loop when `destination.credentialId` is set, which is inherently sequential across destinations. Similarly, in `updateCalendarEvents`, it iterates `for (const reference of calendarReference)` and may `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside the loop before calling `updateEvent(...)`. This makes total latency scale roughly linearly with the number of destination calendars/references. This is a valid performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, but not a correctness defect.
